record.summary: Persistence for observed events and full-tree snapshots: a WAL-mode bun:sqlite database at data/observatory.db with three tables (events, snapshots, snapshot_entries), append-only by construction (no code path updates or deletes rows), plus the --since parser and the glob-to-LIKE translator the query commands share. Metadata only: no file content is ever persisted.
record.title: Append-only SQLite event store and snapshots
